speech_verification.heard: Workers at the Appel plant used dynamite to loosen their fertilizer. They believed the hardened nitrogen stockpile was safe and stable. On September 21, 1921, a routine blast triggered a massive detonation. The explosion killed over 500 people and wounded nearly 2,000. Manufacturing change had secretly turned the pile into a bomb. Unsuspecting workers at the Appel plant used dynamite to loosen their fertilizer.
